app.name: CreatorOS
app.tagline: Plan, adapt, and ship your next 30 posts.

shell.tagline: Plan, adapt, and ship your next 30 posts.

topbar.title: Good morning, Team
topbar.description: Here's what's happening with your content today.

theme.systemAria: Theme: System. Click to switch theme.
theme.title: Theme: {current}

signIn.title: Sign in to your workspace
signIn.description: Use Clerk to access your authenticated workspace. Judges can still open the demo path without creating an account.
signIn.unconfiguredDescription: The authenticated sign-in flow needs a Clerk publishable key. The demo workspace remains available.

signUp.title: Create your workspace
signUp.description: Create a Clerk-backed workspace for your own content operations data. The public judge demo remains available without signup.
signUp.unconfiguredDescription: The sign-up flow needs a Clerk publishable key. Use the demo workspace until Clerk resources are connected.

hero.title: CreatorOS command center
hero.description: Plan, adapt, publish, measure, and feed the next 30-day cycle from one workspace.

onboarding.title: Set the account DNA
onboarding.description: The demo path starts here: positioning context becomes a 30-day plan, then platform rewrites and insights.

demoSafe.title: Demo-safe behavior
demoSafe.demoWorkspace: Unauthenticated judges use the isolated DEMO#judge workspace.
demoSafe.dynamoFallback: When DynamoDB is unconfigured, the server returns deterministic demo data instead of blocking the flow.
demoSafe.userWorkspace: Real Clerk user workspaces use USER#clerkUserId after Clerk resources are configured.

accountDnaForm.title: Account DNA
accountDnaForm.description: This context powers the monthly plan and platform rewrites.
accountDnaForm.goalsHint: One goal per line, or comma-separated.

messages.generatingPlan: Account DNA saved. Generating the 30-day plan...

errors.goalsMaxItems: You can enter up to {max} goals.
errors.goalItemMaxLength: Each goal must be at most {max} characters.
errors.saveFailed: Account DNA could not be saved.
errors.planFailed: Monthly plan could not be generated.
errors.unexpected: Onboarding could not be completed. Try again.

empty.title: No posts planned yet.
empty.description: Generate a monthly plan from Account DNA to fill the calendar.

rewrite.title: Platform Rewrite
rewrite.description: Adapt the same idea for each channel without changing the source post.

empty.title: No rewrite for this platform yet.
empty.description: Generate a validated variant to keep it tied to this post.

preview.title: Platform preview
preview.unsupported: Visual mockup is not available for YouTube yet. Use the raw rewrite copy for this platform.

hook.title: Hook Enhancer
hook.description: Generate three alternative openers, then apply one locally to preview the stronger opening.

messages.applied: Hook applied locally. Generate a rewrite to persist a full variant.

errors.generateFailed: Hook options could not be generated.

tone.title: Tone Sandbox
tone.description: Re-run this platform variant with a focused tone override.

status.title: Workflow Status
status.description: Version {version}; status writes use conflict-aware payloads.

messages.updated: Status update accepted through the server boundary.

metrics.title: Metrics

sync.title: Sync Live Stats
sync.description: Paste a public YouTube video ID to pull views, likes, and comments without OAuth. Try GpQSUjNsNm0 or S5xNFmAR2xk.

messages.synced: Live YouTube stats synced in {mode} mode.

errors.failed: Live stats could not be synced.
errors.externalIdMaxLength: YouTube video ID must be at most 120 characters.

errors.invalidMetric: All metric values must be non-negative integers.

metrics.empty: No metrics recorded for this post yet.

analytics.title: Analytics and insights
analytics.description: Manual metrics feed the next planning cycle. CSV import is represented through a server-side S3 presign boundary.

csv.title: CSV metrics import
csv.description: Download the template, upload raw metrics to S3 when configured, preview row deltas, then commit valid rows into the feedback loop.
csv.columns: Required columns: postId, platform, publishedAt, views, likes, comments, saves, followersGained

messages.s3Unconfigured: S3 is not configured. Metrics can still be committed after local validation.

errors.invalidRows: Fix invalid rows before committing metrics.
errors.backupFailed: Raw CSV backup failed. You can still commit validated metrics.

tasks.title: Action items
tasks.description: Turn the latest insights into concrete next-cycle work cards.

errors.generateFailed: Action items could not be generated.
errors.updateFailed: Task status could not be updated.

empty.title: No action items yet.
empty.description: Generate task cards from stored insights after metrics are imported.

emptyMetrics.title: No metrics yet.
emptyMetrics.description: Add manual metrics on a post detail page.

insightGenerator.title: Generate Next-cycle Insight
insightGenerator.description: Uses the current plan and manual metrics, with fallback if AI is unconfigured.

settings.title: AI Provider
settings.description: Configure the OpenAI-compatible endpoint used by future planning, rewrite, draft, and insight workflows. Secrets stay on the server and are never sent back to the browser.

aiSettings.title: OpenAI-compatible provider
aiSettings.description: Configure a provider once for the global admin workspace. Leave the API key field blank to keep the saved key.

placeholders.keepKey: Leave blank to keep saved key

keySummary.newKey: New key will replace the saved key when you save.

aiSettings.enableDescription: When disabled, future generation flows should use demo or mock fallback instead of blocking the MVP path.
